parameters.help_en: The ID of the pipeline job. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/438042.html to obtain the ID of the pipeline job
parameters.help_zh: 工作流任务ID。如何获取工作流任务ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/438042.html
parameters.name: pipeline_run_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return detailed information. Valid values:

false: does not return detailed information.
true: returns detailed information that contains Manifest
parameters.help_zh:
是否返回详细信息，取值如下。
关闭开关：不显示详细信息。
打开开关：显示详细信息，目前详细信息包含Manifest字段
parameters.name: verbose

parameters.help_en:
The type of the manifest to be returned. Valid values:

Raw (default): the original manifest submitted by the user.
Frozen: generates a UUID for each pipeline and freeze the pipeline version. Even if you upgrade the pipeline when the three tuples defined on a node remain unchanged, the original UUID is still used. In this case, you can re-run the pipeline based on this manifest.
Rendered: injects related information to the pipeline and renders it, including completing runtime environment information and optimizing pipeline configurations.
Expanded: provides a complete definition for each pipeline.
Runtime: the pipeline to be run
parameters.help_zh:
具体返回哪种类型的Manifest信息，取值如下。
Raw（默认）：用户提交的原始Manifest。
Frozen：针对每个Pipeline生成唯一Uuid，将其版本固化下来。即使遇到子Pipeline定义三元组不变进行升级，依然会使用一开始的版本(Uuid)，不受影响；即可基于该Manifest进行重跑。
Rendered：将相关信息进行注入和渲染，包括：补全运行环境信息并优化等。
Expanded: 针对每个Pipeline补充完整定义。
Runtime：待运行的工作流
parameters.name: manifest_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the shared pipeline job
parameters.help_zh: 被分享的工作流任务的ID
parameters.name: token_id
